title: The Nuclease Domain of E. coli RecBCD Regulates DNA Binding and Base Pair Melting
authors: Linxuan Hao; Rui Zhang; Timothy M. Lohman
one_liner_zh: 该文研究E. coli RecBCD核酸酶结构域对DNA结合与碱基对熔解的调控，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作机制研究，但非典型TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验和冷冻电镜为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，故评分为6。
abstract: E. coli RecBCD, a hetero-trimeric helicase and nuclease, functions in double stranded (ds) DNA break repair and in degrading foreign DNA. RecBCD possesses ATPase motor domains within both RecB (3’ to 5’) and RecD (5’ to 3’) and a nuclease domain within RecB (RecB Nuc ). RecBCD binds to double stranded DNA ends and initiates DNA unwinding by first melting several DNA base pairs (bp) using only its binding free energy. The RecB Nuc domain is docked ∼70 Å from the duplex DNA binding site in RecBCD-DNA structures but appears to be dynamic and able to move from its docked position. Here, we compare DNA binding of RecBCD and a variant, RecB ΔNuc CD, in which the 30 kDa nuclease domain has been deleted. RecBCD binding to a blunt DNA end is enthalpically unfavorable and entropically driven. Deletion of RecB Nuc results in an increase in DNA binding affinity, suggesting an allosteric effect of RecB Nuc . RecB ΔNuc CD binding to DNA possessing fully ‘pre-melted’ DNA ends is associated with a large favorable ΔH obs , but much smaller than observed for RecBCD, suggesting that deletion of RecB Nuc limits bp melting from a blunt DNA. We also solved cryo-EM structures showing only 4 bp melted upon RecB ΔNuc CD binding to a blunt ended DNA duplex, less than the 11 bp melted upon RecBCD binding. Thus, the RecB nuclease domain regulates the extent of bp melting by RecBCD. These results also suggest that RecB Nuc may manifest its long-range allosteric effect on DNA binding and DNA melting via linker-linker interactions between RecB and RecC.
abstract_zh: 大肠杆菌RecBCD是一种异源三聚体解旋酶和核酸酶，在双链（ds）DNA断裂修复和降解外源DNA中发挥作用。RecBCD在RecB（3'至5'）和RecD（5'至3'）内均具有ATP酶马达结构域，并在RecB内具有一个核酸酶结构域（RecB Nuc）。RecBCD结合双链DNA末端，并首先仅利用其结合自由能熔解几个DNA碱基对（bp）来启动DNA解旋。在RecBCD-DNA结构中，RecB Nuc结构域停靠在与双链DNA结合位点相距约70 Å的位置，但似乎具有动态性，并能从其停靠位置移动。在此，我们比较了RecBCD与一种变体RecB ΔNuc CD（其中30 kDa核酸酶结构域已被删除）的DNA结合情况。RecBCD与平末端DNA的结合在焓上不利，而由熵驱动。删除RecB Nuc导致DNA结合亲和力增加，表明RecB Nuc存在变构效应。RecB ΔNuc CD与具有完全“预熔解”DNA末端的DNA结合时，伴随较大的有利ΔH obs，但远小于RecBCD所观察到的值，这表明删除RecB Nuc限制了从平末端DNA开始的碱基对熔解。我们还解析了冷冻电镜结构，显示RecB ΔNuc CD结合平末端DNA双链时仅熔解了4个碱基对，少于RecBCD结合时熔解的11个碱基对。因此，RecB核酸酶结构域调控RecBCD的碱基对熔解程度。这些结果还表明，RecB Nuc可能通过RecB与RecC之间的连接子-连接子相互作用，对DNA结合和DNA熔解发挥其长程变构效应。
